title: This issue may allow an authenticated IPMI Administrator to read and write arbitrary BMC physical memory and thereby…
description: An authenticated IPMI Administrator can read and write arbitrary physical memory on the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC), potentially allowing execution of code on the BMC operating system. This vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.2, indicating significant confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts. No specific affected versions or patches are provided in the available data.
